title: Ukufuna indawo yokuhlala
description: Ten short stories about living and housing: a researcher looking for a room in Durban, a boy who moves to his grandfather's farm, a cold house in winter, a burglary, a fake landlord, an old house pulled down for a new one, an overgrown garden, a naughty boy and his neighbour, a grandmother's house by the sea, and life in a school boarding house.

lessons.title: Igumbi likaNokwanda
lessons.summary: Young researcher Nokwanda, new to Durban and staying in an expensive hotel, finds a room on her cellphone; on her lunch break she follows Mfundo's directions, turning off at the school and right, and the honest landlord tells her the roof lets in rain.
lessons.text:
UNokwanda ungumcwaningi omusha. Wenza ucwaningo ngezinhlanzi nangezilwane zolwandle. Ngenyanga edlule wafika eThekwini evela eGoli, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe omusha useduze nolwandle. Kodwa uNokwanda akanayo indawo yokuhlala eThekwini. Ngakho uhlala ehhotela elincane eduze nolwandle. Ihhotela lihle futhi lihlanzekile, kodwa libiza imali eningi. Umcwaningi omusha akanayo imali eningi. UNokwanda uthi: "Angikwazi ukuhlala ehhotela unyaka wonke. Ngidinga igumbi lami."

Njalo ekuseni uNokwanda ubheka umakhalekhukhwini wakhe. Ufuna igumbi elingabizi kakhulu, eliseduze nomsebenzi wakhe. NgoLwesithathu ubona la mazwi kumakhalekhukhwini wakhe: "Igumbi liyaqashwa. Shayela uMfundo." UNokwanda ushayela uMfundo ngomakhalekhukhwini wakhe.

"Sawubona, baba. NginguNokwanda. Igumbi likhona na?"

"Yebo, likhona," kusho uMfundo.

"Bangaki abantu abahlala endlini?"

"Sibathathu: mina, umfazi wami nengane yethu."

"Mangaki amaminithi ukusuka olwandle?"

"Ngamaminithi ayishumi ngezinyawo."

UMfundo umchazela indlela. "Uma uphuma ehhotela, hamba emgwaqweni omkhulu. Ngemuva kwamaminithi amahlanu uzobona isikole. Phambuka lapho, ungene emgwaqweni omncane. Bese ujika ngasekunene. Indlu yethu ingeyesithathu ngasekunene. Inophahla oluluhlaza."

UNokwanda ubhala konke encwadini yakhe. Ubuza: "Ngingafika namuhla emini?" UMfundo uthi kulungile.

Emini uNokwanda uthatha ikhefu emsebenzini. Ikhefu lakhe lingamaminithi angamashumi amane kuphela, ngakho uyashesha. Ngemuva kwamaminithi amahlanu ubona isikole. Uphambuka lapho, ungena emgwaqweni omncane. Bese ujika ngasekunene. Ubona indlu yesithathu ngasekunene, enophahla oluluhlaza.

UMfundo uvula umnyango. Umbonisa igumbi. Igumbi lihlanzekile, futhi linokukhanya okuningi. "Lo mgwaqo omncane uxhumanisa izindlu zethu nolwandle," kusho uMfundo. "Uxhumanisa futhi le ndawo nomgwaqo omkhulu."

UMfundo ungumuntu oqotho. Uthi: "Ngifuna ukukutshela iqiniso. Uma imvula ina kakhulu, amanzi angena ngophahla kancane. Ngizolulungisa ngenyanga ezayo." UNokwanda uyajabula, ngoba abantu abaqotho abavamile. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokungitshela iqiniso. Ngiyalithanda igumbi."

Ngemuva kwamaminithi angamashumi amane uNokwanda ubuyela emsebenzini. Ikhefu lakhe liphelile, kodwa uyajabula. NgoLwesihlanu uphuma ehhotela. Uthatha izikhwama zakhe, uphambuka esikoleni, ujika ngasekunene. Manje umcwaningi omusha unegumbi lakhe, futhi akasadingi ihhotela.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNokwanda ehlala ehhotela?
Ngoba akanayo indawo yokuhlala eThekwini.
UNokwanda ushayela uMfundo ngani?
Umshayela ngomakhalekhukhwini wakhe.
Bangaki abantu abahlala endlini kaMfundo?
Bathathu: uMfundo, umfazi wakhe nengane yabo.
UNokwanda ujika ngasekunene na?
Kunjalo, ujika ngasekunene ngemuva kokuphambuka esikoleni.
Kungani uNokwanda ethi uMfundo ungumuntu oqotho?
Ngoba uMfundo umtshela iqiniso ngophahla.

lessons.title: Emaphandleni nomkhulu
lessons.summary: Ten-year-old Wandile goes to live with his grandfather Mpiyakhe in the countryside near Ixopo; he feeds the chickens and pigs, learns to milk the cow, tastes the sour milk, and in September they plough the field with the donkey and sow sorghum.
lessons.text:
UWandile uneminyaka eyishumi. Wakhulela eThekwini, edolobheni elikhulu. Kulo nyaka abazali bakhe bathola umsebenzi kwelinye izwe. Ngakho uWandile uya kumkhulu wakhe, uMpiyakhe, ukuze ahlale naye emaphandleni eduze naseXopo. UWandile akawazi kahle amaphandle. Uyesaba kancane.

UMpiyakhe uhlala emzini omncane phezu kwentaba. Indlu yakhe incane, kodwa igceke likhulu. Umkhulu kaWandile ufuya izilwane eziningi. Ufuya izinkukhu, izingulube ezimbili, inkomo eyodwa nembongolo endala. Ekuseni kokuqala uMpiyakhe uthi: "Wandile, emaphandleni wonke umuntu uyasebenza. Uzongisiza ngezilwane."

Njalo ekuseni uWandile uvuka ngehora lesihlanu. Unika izinkukhu ummbila. Izinkukhu zigijima kuye, zidla ummbila phansi. Bese uqoqa amaqanda. Ngemuva kwalokho unika izingulube ukudla okusele. Izingulube ziyakuthanda ukudla. Zidla kakhulu, futhi zinkulu. Imbongolo yona idla utshani eduze nomuzi.

UMpiyakhe ukhipha ubisi enkomeni. Uhlala eduze nayo, ugeza ibele layo ngamanzi. Ubonisa uWandile: "Bamba ibele kanje. Donsa kancane." UWandile uzama. Ekuqaleni ubisi aluphumi. Uzama futhi. Manje ubisi luyaphuma ebeleni. UWandile uyahleka. Uthi: "Mkhulu, ngiyakwazi!"

Umkhulu ufaka ubisi esitsheni. Uthi: "Ubisi luzohlala esitsheni izinsuku ezintathu. Bese lube ngamasi." Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu bayavula isitsha. Manje ubisi lungamasi. UWandile udla amasi okokuqala. Amnandi kakhulu.

NgoSepthemba umkhulu uthi: "Isikhathi sokwandula sesifikile." Ukwandula kusho ukuqala ukulima insimu ngemuva kwezinyanga ezibandayo. Imbongolo iyadonsa, uMpiyakhe uyalima, uWandile uhamba ngaphambi kwembongolo. Bandula insimu yonke ngezinsuku ezimbili. Imbongolo ikhathele, kodwa insimu ilungile.

Ngemuva kokwandula batshala amabele. Umkhulu uthi: "Amabele akhula kahle lapha emaphandleni. Ngawo sizokwenza ukudla okumnandi." UWandile ufaka imbewu yamabele emhlabathini. Umkhulu umbonisa ukuthi kufanele afake imbewu kanjani.

Kusihlwa bahlala ndawonye. Badla ukudla kwamabele namasi. UWandile uthi: "Mkhulu, ngiyawathanda amaphandle. Ngiyazithanda izinkukhu, izingulube, imbongolo nenkomo yakho. Ngiyawathanda namasi." UMpiyakhe uyajabula. Uthi: "Uzoba umlimi omuhle, mfana wami."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uWandile eya emaphandleni?
Ngoba abazali bakhe bathola umsebenzi kwelinye izwe, ngakho uya kumkhulu wakhe ukuze ahlale naye.
UMpiyakhe ufuya ziphi izilwane?
Ufuya izinkukhu, izingulube ezimbili, inkomo eyodwa nembongolo endala.
UWandile ukhipha ubisi ebeleni lenkomo na?
Kunjalo, ekuqaleni aluphumi, kodwa ekugcineni luyaphuma ebeleni.
Amasi enziwa kanjani?
Umkhulu ufaka ubisi esitsheni izinsuku ezintathu, bese lube ngamasi.
Bandula insimu ngani?
Bandula ngembongolo, uMpiyakhe uyalima.

lessons.title: Ubusika eMtshezi
lessons.summary: In a cold Estcourt winter Silindile and her son Sakhile stop the wind: they stuff a hole in the wall with torn cloth and patch it with mud and stones, plait a grass rope to hang a blanket over the door, and cook meat slowly over coals until the house is warm.
lessons.text:
USilindile uhlala eMtshezi nendodana yakhe encane, uSakhile. Indlu yabo indala futhi incane. Ehlobo indlu ilungile, kodwa ebusika iyabanda kakhulu. EMtshezi ubusika bunzima: umoya uyabanda, futhi ebusuku kubanda kakhulu.

NgoJuni ubusika bufika. Ngobusuku bokuqala uSakhile uthi: "Mama, ngiyabanda. Umoya ungena endlini." USilindile ubheka udonga eduze nomnyango. Ubona imbobo enkulu odongeni. Umoya obandayo ungena ngaleyo mbobo. USilindile uthatha ingubo endala. Uyayidabula, uyidabula ibe yizingxenye ezincane. USakhile naye udabula enye ingubo endala. Bafaka izingxenye zezingubo embobeni. Manje umoya awungeni kakhulu.

Ngomgqibelo uSilindile uthi: "Namuhla sizokhanda udonga." Uthatha umhlabathi namatshe amancane. USakhile uletha amanzi. Bobabili bakhanda imbobo ngomhlabathi omanzi namatshe. Bakhanda kahle kakhulu, baze bavale imbobo yonke. USilindile uthi: "Manje udonga luqinile. Imbobo ayisekho."

Kodwa umnyango nawo udinga ukulungiswa. Ngaphansi komnyango kukhona isikhala, futhi umoya ungena khona. USilindile uthatha ingubo enkulu, eqinile. Kodwa udinga intambo eqinile ukuze ayilengise.

Ngakho uSilindile uluka intambo ngotshani obomile. Uluka emini yonke. USakhile uyambuka, bese naye uzama ukuluka. Ekuqaleni akakwazi, kodwa umama wakhe uyamsiza. Ekugcineni intambo inde futhi iqinile. USilindile ubopha intambo phezu komnyango, alengise ingubo kuyo. Ingubo ilenga phansi, ize ifike phansi. Uma umoya ufika, ingubo ilenga lapho futhi ivimba umoya.

Emini bafuna ukukhanya endlini. Ngakho ekuseni uSilindile uyayigoqa ingubo emnyango. Uyigoqa kahle, ayibophe phezulu ngentambo. Kusihlwa uyayivula futhi, bese ingubo ilenga emnyango ubusuku bonke. Nezingubo zokulala uyazigoqa ekuseni, azibeke embhedeni.

Kusihlwa uSilindile ubasa amalahle esitsheni sensimbi. Amalahle ashisa kakhulu, futhi ayakhanya. USilindile ushiya umnyango uvuleke kancane, ngoba amalahle endlini evaliwe ayingozi. Upheka inyama phezu kwamalahle. Inyama idinga isikhathi eside ukuze ivuthwe. Ngemuva kwehora uyabheka. Inyama isilukhuni. Ngemuva kwamahora amabili uyabheka futhi. Manje inyama ivuthiwe. Inyama evuthiwe imnandi kakhulu ebusika.

Manje indlu iyafudumala. Imbobo odongeni ayisekho. Ingubo ilenga emnyango. USakhile udla inyama evuthiwe eduze namalahle. Uthi: "Mama, indlu yethu iyafudumala." USilindile uyajabula. Uthi: "Ubusika bulukhuni, kodwa thina sifudumele."

Imibuzo:
Kungani indlu kaSilindile ibanda ebusika?
Ngoba kukhona imbobo odongeni, futhi umoya obandayo ungena ngayo.
USilindile noSakhile bakhanda imbobo ngani?
Bayikhanda ngomhlabathi omanzi namatshe amancane.
Ingubo enkulu ilenga kuphi?
Ilenga phezu komnyango, ize ifike phansi.
Ekuseni uSilindile wenzani ngengubo esemnyango?
Uyayigoqa, ayibophe phezulu ngentambo, ukuze kungene ukukhanya.
Kungani uSilindile ebheka inyama kabili?
Ngoba inyama idinga isikhathi eside ukuze ivuthwe.

lessons.title: Umfokazi eNtuzuma
lessons.summary: Senzo comes home to find his rented house in Ntuzuma burgled and his computer gone; an old neighbour saw a stranger climb the back wall, the investigator says he will be back, and the neighbours guard the street until they catch him.
lessons.text:
USenzo uqasha indlu encane eNtuzuma. Uhlala yedwa, futhi usebenza edolobheni kusukela ekuseni kuze kube kusihlwa. Indlu yakhe incane, kodwa iyamjabulisa. Ngemuva kwendlu kukhona udonga oluphansi.

NgoLwesibili uSenzo ubuya emsebenzini kusihlwa. Ufika emnyango, bese uyethuka. Umnyango uvulekile, futhi ukhiye wawo awusebenzi. USenzo ungena endlini. Izinto zakhe ziphansi yonke indawo. Ikhompyutha yakhe inyamalele. Imali yakhe ebhokisini nayo inyamalele. USenzo uyabona ukuthi izigebengu zigqekeze indlu yakhe.

USenzo ushayela amaphoyisa. Ngemuva kwehora kufika umhloli wamaphoyisa. Umhloli ubheka umnyango, ubheka nezinto eziphansi. Ubuza: "Yini enye enyamalele?" USenzo uthi: "Ikhompyutha yami nemali yami. Ezinye izinto azinyamalalanga."

Ngaleso sikhathi kufika umakhelwane wakhe, ugogo ohlala eduze. Uthi: "Emini ngibone umfokazi lapha ekhwela udonga ngemuva kwendlu yakho. Bese ehamba ejaha, ephethe isikhwama esikhulu." Umhloli uyabuza: "Lo mfokazi unjani?" Ugogo uthi: "Mude, ugqoke ingubo emnyama. Angimazi. Ungumfokazi kule ndawo."

Umhloli uthi: "Kulo nyaka izigebengu zigqekeze izindlu eziningi eNtuzuma. Izigebengu ezigqekeza izindlu zivame ukukhwela udonga ngemuva. Lo mfokazi uzobuya nakanjani, ngoba uyazi ukuthi le ndawo ilula." USenzo uthi: "Ngizokhokha umvuzo kumuntu ongisiza ukuthola izinto zami."

Ngakusasa uSenzo ubiza omakhelwane bakhe. Uthi: "Sidinga ukunqanda lezi zigebengu. Masigade umgwaqo wethu ebusuku." Omakhelwane bayavuma. Njalo ebusuku amadoda amathathu agada umgwaqo. Bagada kusukela ngehora leshumi kuze kube sekuseni. Uma kufika umfokazi, bayambuza ukuthi uyaphi.

NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku amadoda abona umfokazi ekhwela udonga lwendlu kagogo. Uyajaha, kodwa amadoda agijima ngokushesha kunaye. Ayambamba, bese ashayela umhloli. Umhloli uthi: "Nguye lo mfokazi." Umhloli uthi: "Bengazi ukuthi uzobuya nakanjani." Ngakusasa amaphoyisa athola ikhompyutha kaSenzo endlini yalo mfokazi.

USenzo uyajabula kakhulu. Unika ugogo umvuzo, ngoba umbone kuqala lo mfokazi. Kodwa ugogo uthi: "Angiwudingi umvuzo. Ngiyajabula ngoba sinqande izigebengu." Ngakho uSenzo uthenga ukudla okumnandi, abelane ngakho nomakhelwane bonke. Manje omakhelwane bathi bazoqhubeka begada umgwaqo wabo nakanjani.

Imibuzo:
Yini enyamalele endlini kaSenzo?
Ikhompyutha yakhe nemali yakhe kunyamalele.
Ugogo wabona umfokazi enzani?
Wambona ekhwela udonga ngemuva kwendlu, bese ehamba ejaha.
Kungani umhloli ethi umfokazi uzobuya?
Ngoba uyazi ukuthi le ndawo ilula.
Omakhelwane banqanda izigebengu kanjani?
Bagada umgwaqo wabo ebusuku.
Kungani ugogo engawudingi umvuzo?
Ngoba uyajabula ngokuthi omakhelwane banqande izigebengu.

lessons.title: Indlu engekho
lessons.summary: Nursing student Nokukhanya of Pietermaritzburg is talked into paying for a house she has not seen; the polite man turns rude and the house is not his, she cries with shame, her boyfriend Nhlakanipho takes her to the police, and she keeps a reminder on her phone.
lessons.text:
UNokukhanya ufundela ukusebenza esibhedlela eMgungundlovu. Kulo nyaka ufuna ukushiya indlu yabazali bakhe, ahlale yedwa. Ngakho ufuna indawo yokuhlala eduze nesibhedlela. Isoka lakhe, uNhlakanipho, liyamsiza ukufuna. Babheka izindlu eziningi, kodwa zonke zibiza imali eningi kakhulu.

NgoMsombuluko uNokukhanya ubona indlu enhle kumakhalekhukhwini wakhe. Indlu inamagumbi amabili, futhi ayibizi kakhulu. Ushayela indoda ethi indlu ingeyayo. Indoda iyambingelela kahle. Ithi: "Sawubona, sisi. Unjani namuhla?" UNokukhanya uyajabula, ngoba indoda ibingelela kahle kangaka.

Indoda ithi: "Abantu abaningi bayayifuna le ndlu. Uma ufuna ukuyithola, thumela imali yenyanga yokuqala namuhla." UNokukhanya uthi: "Ngicela ukuyibona kuqala." Kodwa indoda iyamanelisa. Ithi: "Angikho eMgungundlovu kuleli sonto. Ngizokuthumelela izithombe. Ngizokunika ukhiye ngoMgqibelo." Izithombe zinhle kakhulu. Ekugcineni indoda iyamanelisa ngempela.

UNokukhanya utshela isoka lakhe. UNhlakanipho uthi: "Ungathumeli imali ngaphambi kokuthi ubone indlu. Lindela uMgqibelo." Kodwa uNokukhanya uthi: "Le ndoda ingumuntu oqotho. Ibingelela kahle, futhi izithombe zinhle." Uthumela imali.

NgoMgqibelo uNokukhanya uya endlini. Kodwa endlini kuhlala umama omdala. Lo mama uthi: "Le ndlu ngeyami. Angikaze ngiyiqashise." UNokukhanya ushayela indoda. Manje indoda iyamdelela. Iyahleka, ithi: "Imali yakho ayisekho, ntombazane." Bese ivala ucingo. UNokukhanya uyabona ukuthi indoda imkhwabanisile.

UNokukhanya uhlala phansi eduze komgwaqo, ulila. Ulila isikhathi eside. Unamahloni amakhulu. Uthi: "UNhlakanipho wangitshela. Manje ngizomtshela kanjani?" Kodwa ekugcineni uyamshayela. Uthi: "Ngikhwabanisiwe. Ngiyaxolisa, bekufanele ngikulalele." Ulila futhi.

UNhlakanipho uyafika ngemoto. Akamthethisi. Uthi: "Ungabi namahloni. Abantu abaningi bayakhwabaniswa kanjena. Lo muntu uyabadelela abantu, futhi uyabakhwabanisa. Masiye emaphoyiseni." Baya emaphoyiseni bobabili. Amaphoyisa athi le ndoda ikhwabanise abantu abaningi kulo nyaka.

Kusihlwa uNokukhanya ubhala isikhumbuzo kumakhalekhukhwini wakhe: "Ungathumeli imali ngaphambi kokubona indlu." Ubheka lesi sikhumbuzo njalo uma ebheka izindlu. Ngemuva kwenyanga uthola indlu encane yomama oqotho. Ubona indlu kuqala, bese ekhokha. UNokukhanya uthi kuNhlakanipho: "Ngiyakuthokozela kakhulu. Wangisiza ngesikhathi ngilila." UNhlakanipho uyahleka. Uthi: "Nami ngiyakuthokozela, sithandwa sami."

Imibuzo:
Indoda yanelisa uNokukhanya kanjani?
Yambingelela kahle futhi yamthumelela izithombe ezinhle zendlu.
UNhlakanipho wathi uNokukhanya kufanele enzeni?
Wathi akufanele athumele imali ngaphambi kokuthi abone indlu.
Kwenzekani lapho uNokukhanya eshayela indoda ngoMgqibelo?
Indoda iyamdelela, iyahleka, bese ivala ucingo.
Kungani uNokukhanya enamahloni?
Ngoba isoka lakhe lamtshela, kodwa yena akalalelanga.
UNokukhanya ubhala siphi isikhumbuzo?
Ubhala ukuthi akufanele athumele imali ngaphambi kokubona indlu.

lessons.title: Indlu entsha kaSimphiwe
lessons.summary: Simphiwe of Melmoth and his mother pull down his late grandfather's old house, where he once told folk tales; inside a wall the builder Ntando finds the old hunting spear, the workers bend iron and eat their fill after work, and neighbours call the new house a wonder.
lessons.text:
USimphiwe uhlala eMelmoth nomama wakhe. Emzini wabo kukhona indlu endala kakhulu. Kudala kwakuhlala umkhulu kaSimphiwe kuyo. Umkhulu washona eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, futhi manje indlu indala kakhulu. Udonga lunezimbobo, futhi uphahla lungawa. USimphiwe uthi: "Mama, masiyidilize le ndlu endala. Sizokwakha indlu entsha yamatshe." Umama uyavuma, kodwa uyadabuka kancane.

Kusihlwa umama uhlala eduze kwendlu endala. Uthi: "Kule ndlu umkhulu wakho wasitshela izinganekwane eziningi ebusuku." Umtshela inganekwane ayithanda kakhulu: inganekwane yendoda eyahamba ehlathini yathola inyoni ekhulumayo. USimphiwe uyayikhumbula le nganekwane. Uthi: "Mama, sizozigcina izinganekwane zikamkhulu, noma indlu ingasekho."

NgoMsombuluko kufika umakhi, uNtando, nabasebenzi bakhe ababili. Baqala ukudiliza indlu endala. Badiliza uphahla kuqala, bese bediliza izindonga. Lapho bediliza udonga lokugcina, uNtando uthola into ende phakathi kodonga. Umkhonto omdala! USimphiwe uyamangala. Umama uthi: "Lo ngumkhonto kamkhulu wakho. Wazingela ngawo eyinsizwa. Wazingela izilwane ehlathini ngalo mkhonto." USimphiwe uthatha umkhonto, awugcine kahle.

Emva kokudiliza indlu, uNtando nabasebenzi bakhe baqala ukwakha. UNtando ubeka amatshe. Abasebenzi bagoba izinsimbi ezinde. Bazigoba kancane, ngoba izinsimbi ziqinile. Izinsimbi ezigobile zenza udonga luqine. UNtando uthi: "Phakathi kwendlu yenu nendlu yomakhelwane kufanele kube nomkhathi omkhulu." Ngakho bashiya umkhathi wamamitha amahlanu phakathi kwezindlu ezimbili.

Njalo ngehora lesine abasebenzi bayashayisa. Uma beshayisa, umama kaSimphiwe ubapha isidlo. Isidlo sakhe sinenyama, isinkwa nemifino. Abasebenzi bayadla baze basuthe. Ngemuva kwesidlo baphuza itiye elinoshukela omningi. UNtando uthi: "Ngifaka ushukela omningi, ngoba ngikhathele." Abasebenzi bayahleka. Bathi: "Sisuthile, mama. Siyabonga ngesidlo."

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili kuphela indlu entsha isiphelile. Inamagumbi amane nophahla oluqinile. Omakhelwane bayeza bezobona. Bathi: "Kuyisimangaliso! Indlu enhle kanje yakhiwe ngezinyanga ezimbili kuphela." UNtando uthi: "Akusiso isimangaliso. Sisebenze kanzima njalo, sashayisa ngehora lesine kuphela."

USimphiwe ulengisa umkhonto kamkhulu odongeni lwendlu entsha. Kusihlwa uhlala nomama wakhe phansi komkhonto. Umama umtshela futhi izinganekwane zikamkhulu. USimphiwe uthi: "Indlu endala idiliziwe, kodwa izinganekwane zikamkhulu sisenazo."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uSimphiwe efuna ukudiliza indlu endala?
Ngoba udonga lunezimbobo futhi uphahla lungawa.
Umkhulu kaSimphiwe wenzani ngomkhonto?
Wazingela izilwane ehlathini ngawo.
Kungani abasebenzi bashiya umkhathi phakathi kwezindlu?
Ngoba uNtando uthi kufanele kube nomkhathi omkhulu phakathi kwendlu yabo nendlu yomakhelwane.
Abasebenzi benzani uma beshayisa?
Badla isidlo sikamama kaSimphiwe baze basuthe, bese bephuza itiye elinoshukela.
Omakhelwane bathi indlu entsha iyini?
Bathi kuyisimangaliso, ngoba yakhiwe ngezinyanga ezimbili kuphela.

lessons.title: Ingadi kaNomzamo
lessons.summary: Retired teacher Nomzamo clears the overgrown garden of her new house in Howick; a thorn makes her hand bleed, her knees and back ache, a frightened kitten scratches her, and the doctor tells her to wash the wounds and rest, so she works in gloves and the garden blooms.
lessons.text:
UNomzamo wayengumfundisi esikoleni iminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Manje uyaphumula ekhaya. Uthenge indlu encane eHowick, ngoba uthanda umoya opholile waleyo ndawo. Ngemuva kwendlu kukhona ingadi enkulu. Kodwa ingadi indala futhi imbi. Akekho umuntu owayinakekela iminyaka eminingi. Kugcwele izihlahla ezinameva.

UNomzamo uthi: "Ngifuna ingadi enhle, enezimbali nemifino." Ngakho ngoMgqibelo uqala ukusebenza engadini. Usika izihlahla ezinameva. Kodwa ameva maningi kakhulu. Iva elikhulu lingena esandleni sakhe. Isandla siyopha. UNomzamo ukhipha iva, futhi ubona inxeba elincane. Igazi liyaphuma enxebeni.

UNomzamo ungena endlini. Ukhumula izicathulo zakhe ezingcolile emnyango. Ugeza inxeba ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ukugeza inxeba kudingeka, ngoba ukungcola kungalenza libe libi. Ngemuva kokugeza, inxeba alisophi. UNomzamo ubopha isandla ngendwangu ehlanzekile.

Ngakusasa uNomzamo uqhubeka nokusebenza engadini. Uhlala phansi ngamadolo, ukhiphe utshani obubi. Usebenza amahora amathathu. Kusihlwa idolo lakhe lesokunene libuhlungu, futhi nomhlane wakhe ubuhlungu. Akakwazi ukuma kahle. Uthi: "Umhlane wami umdala manje. Amadolo ami nawo amadala."

Ngolwesithathu uNomzamo uthola ikati elincane phakathi kwezihlahla ezinameva. Ikati liyesaba futhi lilambile. UNomzamo ulikhipha emeveni. Kodwa ikati liyamlimaza ngamazipho alo. Amazipho alo aqinile futhi made. Ingalo kaNomzamo iyopha futhi. Unenxeba elisha.

Manje uNomzamo uya kudokotela. Udokotela ubheka amanxeba. Uthi: "Amanxeba amancane. Iva alingenanga emthanjeni, futhi amazipho ekati awafikanga emthanjeni omkhulu." Uthi igazi lihamba emithanjeni, futhi inxeba eliseduze nomthambo omkhulu liyingozi. Udokotela umnika umuthi. Uthi: "Geza amanxeba njalo ekuseni. Ukugeza kuzokusiza ukuthi aphole kahle. Futhi ungasebenzi isikhathi eside ngamadolo nangomhlane ogobile."

UNomzamo uyalalela. Manje ugqoka amagilavu uma esebenza engadini. Usebenza ihora elilodwa kuphela, bese ephumula. Uma eqeda, ukhumula amagilavu, ageze izandla. Ngemuva kwamasonto amathathu izihlahla ezinameva azisekho. Kukhona izimbali nemifino engadini. Ikati elincane lihlala noNomzamo. Alisamlimazi ngamazipho alo, ngoba manje liyamthanda. Kusihlwa uNomzamo uhlala engadini yakhe, ikati lilele phezu kwamadolo akhe.

Imibuzo:
Kungani isandla sikaNomzamo siyopha?
Ngoba iva elikhulu lingena esandleni sakhe.
UNomzamo wenzani ngaphambi kokugeza inxeba?
Ukhumula izicathulo zakhe ezingcolile emnyango.
Kungani idolo lakhe nomhlane wakhe kubuhlungu?
Ngoba usebenza amahora amathathu ehlala phansi ngamadolo.
Ikati lilimaza uNomzamo ngani?
Limlimaza ngamazipho alo.
Udokotela uthi uNomzamo kufanele enzeni?
Uthi kufanele ageze amanxeba njalo ekuseni, futhi angasebenzi isikhathi eside ngamadolo.

lessons.title: Umakhelwane kaZiyanda
lessons.summary: In Lamontville naughty Luyanda kicks his ball over the wall, spills old Nkululeko's washing water and dirties his clean clothes; the dog only licks him, his mother Ziyanda scolds him, he apologises and is forgiven, and a joke starts a friendship between the neighbours.
lessons.text:
UZiyanda nendodana yakhe, uLuyanda, bathuthela endlini entsha eLamontville ngenyanga edlule. ULuyanda uneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Ungumfana omuhle, kodwa uyaganga kakhulu. Umama wakhe uvame ukumkhuza. Uthi: "Luyanda, ungaganga kanje!" Kodwa uLuyanda uyahleka, bese eganga futhi.

Umakhelwane wabo nguNkululeko, indoda endala ehlala yodwa nenja yayo enkulu. Phakathi kwamagceke amabili kukhona udonga oluphansi. UZiyanda uthi: "Ubuhlobo nomakhelwane buyadingeka. Kufanele sibe nobuhlobo obuhle noNkululeko."

NgoMgqibelo uNkululeko ugeza izingubo zakhe egcekeni. Ubeka isitsha esikhulu samanzi anensipho phansi, abeke izingubo ezihlanzekile eduze kwaso. ULuyanda udlala ngebhola egcekeni lakhe. Uyaganga: ukhahlela ibhola phezulu kakhulu. Ibhola liwa ngaphesheya kodonga, lishaya isitsha sikaNkululeko. Isitsha siyawa, amanzi achitheka. Amanzi achitheka egcekeni lonke, angene nasemhlabathini. Umhlabathi omanzi ungcolisa izingubo ezihlanzekile.

Inja kaNkululeko igijima kulo ibhola, ilibambe ngomlomo. ULuyanda ukhwela udonga ukuze athathe ibhola. Uyesaba ukuthi inja izomluma. Kodwa inja ayimlumi. Imkhotha ebusweni, futhi amathe ayo aphuma emlonyeni wayo, ahlale ebusweni bakhe. Ibhola nalo ligcwele amathe enja.

UNkululeko uphuma endlini. Ubona amanzi achithekile nezingubo ezingcolisiwe. Uthukuthele kakhulu. UZiyanda uyagijima, uyeza. Ukhuza uLuyanda: "Uyabona ukuganga kwakho? Ungcolise izingubo zomakhelwane wethu! Cela uxolo manje."

ULuyanda unamahloni. Uthi: "Baba, ngiyaxolisa. Ngicela ungixolele." UNkululeko uthula isikhathi eside. Bese ethi: "Ngiyakuxolela, mfana. Ungcolise izingubo zami, ngakho uzongisiza ukuzigeza futhi." Bese uNkululeko enza ihlaya: "Inja yami ithanda ibhola kakhulu kunami. Ayilumi abantu, iluma amabhola kuphela!" Bonke bayahleka ngaleli hlaya.

ULuyanda ugeza izingubo noNkululeko ihora lonke. Inja ihlala eduze kwabo. ULuyanda uthinta intamo yenja kancane. Intamo yayo inezinwele ezinde futhi ezithambile. Inja iyakuthanda lokhu, ibeke ikhanda layo ezandleni zakhe, amathe ayo angena ezandleni zakhe.

Kusukela ngalolo suku ubuhlobo phakathi kwemindeni emibili buhle kakhulu. ULuyanda uyaganga namanje, kodwa umama wakhe akamkhuzi njalo. NgeSonto uNkululeko uza ekhaya likaZiyanda ezodla. Ubatshela amahlaya amaningi, futhi bayahleka bonke.

Imibuzo:
Kungani amanzi achitheka egcekeni likaNkululeko?
Ngoba ibhola likaLuyanda lishaya isitsha, isitsha siyawa.
Inja iyamluma uLuyanda na?
Cha, ayimlumi. Imkhotha ebusweni, amathe ayo ahlale ebusweni bakhe.
UZiyanda wenzani lapho ebona izingubo ezingcolisiwe?
Ukhuza uLuyanda, amtshele ukuthi acele uxolo.
UNkululeko uyamxolela uLuyanda na?
Kunjalo, uyamxolela, kodwa uthi uLuyanda uzomsiza ukugeza izingubo futhi.
Lithini ihlaya likaNkululeko?
Lithi inja yakhe ayilumi abantu, iluma amabhola kuphela.

lessons.title: Indlu kagogo ogwini
lessons.summary: After her grandmother Makhosazana's funeral in Scottburgh, where neighbours bring food and a cake and the minister reads a verse, Zandile's family shave their heads as custom asks; she decides to live in the house by the sea and finds her grandmother's wedding ring.
lessons.text:
UZandile usebenza esibhedlela eThekwini. Ugogo wakhe, uMakhosazana, wayehlala yedwa endlini encane ogwini eScottburgh. Indlu kagogo ibheke olwandle, futhi ugu lwalapho luhle kakhulu. NgoNovemba ugogo uyagula, bese eshona. UZandile udabuka kakhulu, ngoba ugogo wamkhulisa eyingane.

Umndeni wonke uhlangana eScottburgh ngomngcwabo. Omakhelwane bayasiza. Umama omunye uzisa izitsha zokudla. Omunye uzisa izihlalo. Indoda yasesontweni ithi: "Ngizozisa itafula elikhulu kusasa." Wonke umuntu ofikayo uzisa okuthile.

NgoMgqibelo kuba umngcwabo. Abantu abaningi bafika emngcwabeni. Umfundisi ufunda ivesi eBhayibhelini. Ivesi likhuluma ngothando nangokuphumula. UZandile uyalithanda leli vesi, ngoba ugogo wayevame ukulifunda. Ngemuva kwalokho umfundisi ufunda elinye ivesi, futhi abantu bacula iculo elidala. Emva komngcwabo bonke badla ndawonye. Umakhelwane ozisa ikhekhe elikhulu uthi: "Ugogo wenu wayelithanda leli khekhe. Ngalenza ngendlela ayengifundise ngayo." Bonke badla ikhekhe, futhi lihle kakhulu.

Ngakusasa amadoda omndeni ayaphuca. Ngokwesiko lamaZulu, ngemuva komngcwabo abantu bomndeni baphuca amakhanda abo. Umalume kaZandile uphuca ikhanda lakhe kuqala, bese ephuca amadodana akhe. Nabesifazane bayaphuca izinwele zabo. UZandile naye uyaphuca. Uthi: "Lobu buhlungu bukhulu, kodwa siphuca ndawonye njengomndeni."

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili umndeni uhlangana futhi. Umalume uthi: "Akekho ohlala endlini kagogo manje. Ubani ozohlala lapha ogwini?" UZandile uthi: "Ngifuna ukuhlala lapha. Ngingathola umsebenzi esibhedlela saseScottburgh." Bonke bayavuma.

UZandile uhlanza indlu kagogo. Egumbini lokulala uthola ibhokisi elincane. Ngaphakathi kwebhokisi kukhona indandatho yegolide nencwadi. Incwadi ithi: "Zandile, le ndandatho yayiyindandatho yami yomshado. Ngiyakunika yona, ntombi yami." UZandile ufaka indandatho emunweni wakhe. Uyakhala, kodwa futhi uyajabula.

Ngalobu busuku uZandile ulala okokuqala endlini kagogo. Uzwa ulwandle. Uphuma ngaphandle, abheke ugu, bese ebheka indandatho emunweni wakhe. Uthi: "Lobu busuku buthule, ugogo. Ngizoyinakekela indlu yakho." Ekuseni uhamba ogwini, phezu kwesihlabathi, njengoba ugogo wayenza njalo ekuseni.

Imibuzo:
Omakhelwane basiza kanjani ngaphambi komngcwabo?
Umama omunye uzisa ukudla, omunye uzisa izihlalo, futhi indoda izisa itafula.
Kungani uZandile elithanda ivesi elifundwa ngumfundisi?
Ngoba ugogo wayevame ukulifunda.
Kungani abantu bomndeni bephuca amakhanda abo?
Ngoba kuyisiko lamaZulu ukuphuca ngemuva komngcwabo.
UZandile uthola indandatho ebhokisini elincane na?
Kunjalo, uthola indandatho yegolide yomshado kagogo nencwadi.
Ubani ozohlala endlini kagogo ogwini?
UZandile uzohlala khona, futhi uzofuna umsebenzi esibhedlela saseScottburgh.

lessons.title: Igumbi leliya eDundee
lessons.summary: Khulekani tells of boarding at a school in Dundee: his voice breaking, cricket and a race, rat poison under the beds, revising slavery and nationhood with his roommate Malusi, and dancing for his father on heritage day.
lessons.text:
NginguKhulekani. Ngineminyaka eyishumi nesithupha, futhi ngifunda esikoleni esikhulu eDundee. Ikhaya lami likude, emaphandleni, ngakho ngihlala esikoleni nabanye abafana. Sihlala emagumbini amakhulu ngemuva kwesikole. Uma ubheka ngaphesheya kwegceke, uzobona igumbi leliya elinomnyango oluhlaza. Igumbi leliya ngelami nelomngane wami, uMalusi.

Kulo nyaka umzimba wami uyashintsha. Umama wathi: "Uyathomba, mntanami. Lokhu kwenzeka kubo bonke abafana." Ngiyathomba ngempela: izwi lami liyashintsha, futhi ngikhula ngokushesha. Ngiyesaba kancane uma izwi lami lishintsha ekilasini, kodwa uMalusi naye uyathomba. Siyahleka ngamazwi ethu amasha.

NgoLwesithathu emini sidlala ikhilikithi. Igceke leliya elikhulu ngemuva kwamagumbi yindawo yethu yekhilikithi. Mina angiyidlali kahle ikhilikithi, kodwa uMalusi uyidlala kahle kakhulu. Uthi: "Ikhilikithi idinga ukubekezela." NgoLwesihlanu kuba umjaho wesikole. Ngiyagijima emjahweni omude. Angibi ngowokuqala, kodwa ngiqeda umjaho, futhi ngiyajabula.

Ngenyanga edlule kwakukhona amagundane egumbini lethu. Umphathi wamagumbi wabeka ubuthi bamagundane phansi kwemibhede. Wathi: "Ningabuthinti lobu buthi. Lobu buthi buyingozi kubantu nasezilwaneni." Sabuyeka ubuthi, futhi ngemuva kwamasonto amabili amagundane anyamalala.

Manje sibukeza izifundo zethu, ngoba ukuhlolwa kuyeza. Kusihlwa mina noMalusi sihlala etafuleni sibukeze. Sibukeza isifundo samakhosi akudala nesifundo sezigqila. Uthisha wasitshela ukuthi kudala abelungu babeletha izigqila eKapa ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Izigqila zazingenawo amalungelo. Zazisebenza kanzima, zingakhokhelwa. Sibukeza futhi ngobuzwe. UMalusi ubuza: "Buyini ubuzwe?" Ngiyamphendula: "Ubuzwe kusho ukuthi abantu bezwe elilodwa bazizwa beyisizwe esisodwa."

NgoSepthemba kuba usuku lwamasiko esikoleni. Sigqoka izingubo zesiko, bese siyasina. Abafana bayasina, abazali bayabuka. Mina ngiyasina ngamandla, ngiphakamisa unyawo phezulu, bese ngilushaya phansi. Ubaba wami uyafika evela emaphandleni ezobona. Uthi: "Khulekani, usina kahle njengomkhulu wakho." Ngiyajabula kakhulu.

Kusihlwa ngibuyela egumbini leliya elinomnyango oluhlaza. Ngibukeza isifundo sezigqila nesobuzwe futhi. Ngikhumbula umjaho, ikhilikithi nokusina. Ukuhlala esikoleni kunzima ngezinye izikhathi, kodwa manje igumbi leliya seliyikhaya lami.

Imibuzo:
UKhulekani uhlala kuphi?
Uhlala egumbini elinomnyango oluhlaza ngemuva kwesikole, noMalusi.
Kungani izwi likaKhulekani lishintsha?
Ngoba uyathomba, njengabo bonke abafana.
Kungani umphathi wathi abafana akufanele bathinte ubuthi?
Ngoba lobu buthi buyingozi kubantu nasezilwaneni.
UKhulekani noMalusi babukeza ziphi izifundo?
Babukeza isifundo samakhosi akudala, isifundo sezigqila nesobuzwe.
Ubaba kaKhulekani uthini ngokusina kwakhe?
Uthi uKhulekani usina kahle njengomkhulu wakhe.
